basis: GAAP (consistent with the mapped GAAP history: revenue F-6fa20ae3f8, gross_profit F-59fdd96a71, operating_income F-8bf147bca4). AMD's margin, opex and tax guidance is non-GAAP; it is bridged to GAAP below using the Q3 2026 GAAP-to-non-GAAP reconciliation in release_ex99_2.txt.

rationales.revenue_qoq: FY2026Q4: guidance midpoint. Q-1 gives revenue of approximately $17.0B plus or minus 3%; $17.0B / $13.377B FY2026Q3 revenue (F-6fa20ae3f8) - 1 = 27.08%, matching the release's stated sequential increase of approximately 27%. Later quarters (analyst judgment): recent sequential trend is accelerating (FY2026Q1 -0.2% from F-e8860f2d21 vs D-da671c66c3; FY2026Q2 +12.5% F-0c22036940; FY2026Q3 +16.0% F-6fa20ae3f8; FY2026Q4 guided +27%), driven by Data Center demand (Q-6: Instinct/EPYC demand strengthening, Helios and Venice production scaling). I deliberately do not extrapolate that acceleration: FY2027Q1 is set at +2% because Q1 has been seasonally flat-to-down (FY2025Q1 -2.9%, F-d0545641b8 vs D-edca811136; FY2026Q1 -0.2%) and it follows a large guided step-up; FY2027Q2 +7% and FY2027Q3 +9% assume the Data Center ramp resumes at a pace below FY2026Q2-Q3 (+12.5%/+16.0%). Downside risks to these later-quarter rates: export restrictions on Instinct MI308 (Q-8) and the year-over-year decline in Client & Gaming disclosed in the release. Implied FY2027Q3 revenue is about $20.2B, roughly +51% y/y, below the +66% y/y implied by the FY2026Q4 guide.
rationales.gross_margin: FY2026Q4: anchored on the guided non-GAAP gross margin of approximately 55% (Q-2), converted to GAAP to match the GAAP history. In FY2026Q3 the GAAP-to-non-GAAP gross-profit adjustments were $273M (SBC $9M, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles $257M, legal loss contingency $7M; release_ex99_2.txt reconciliation), i.e. 2.0 pts on $13.377B revenue. These are largely fixed in dollars, so at $17.0B revenue they are about 1.6 pts, giving 55% - 1.6 pts = 53.4% GAAP. The guide is 1 pt below FY2026Q3 non-GAAP 56%, which I read as rack-scale (Helios) mix and carry forward. Later quarters (judgment): non-GAAP mix held near 55%; GAAP margin edges up to 53.5%, 53.8% and 54.0% only because fixed intangible amortization is spread over higher revenue. This stays within the recent GAAP range (FY2026Q1 52.8%, Q2 53.8%, Q3 53.9% from F-cff929caa2/F-e8860f2d21, F-3a5eb7ca5f/F-0c22036940, F-59fdd96a71/F-6fa20ae3f8; Q-7 attributes the FY2026Q3 year-over-year improvement to favorable Data Center mix).
rationales.opex_pct_revenue: Defined as total GAAP operating expenses (R&D + MG&A + amortization of acquisition-related intangibles in opex) / revenue, so gross profit minus opex reconciles to GAAP operating income (FY2026Q3: $7,210M - $4,378M = $2,832M, F-8bf147bca4). FY2026Q4: guided non-GAAP opex of approximately $3.75B (Q-3), plus the GAAP adjustments seen in FY2026Q3 (SBC in opex $514M, amortization $277M, acquisition-related costs $27M; release_ex99_2.txt) grown slightly (about $535M SBC, $270M amortization, $30M acquisition costs given the pending World Labs and Taalas acquisitions), gives about $4.59B, which is 27.0% of $17.0B. This compares with 32.7% in FY2026Q3 ($4,378M / $13,377M) and 36.5% in FY2026Q2. Later quarters (judgment): GAAP opex dollars grow about 5% q/q, in line with the guided non-GAAP step from $3,560M to $3,750M (+5.3%) and GAAP growth of about 4% from FY2026Q2 to Q3 ($4,213M to $4,378M). On the revenue path above that gives 27.8%, 27.2% and 26.2%. FY2027Q1 rises because revenue growth is seasonally low while spending keeps growing.
rationales.tax_rate: 13%, the guided effective tax rate (Q-4), which the release describes as AMD's projected normalized non-GAAP rate for fiscal 2026. Recent GAAP effective rates cannot be used as a run-rate. The 10-Q (periodic.txt, income taxes note) reports (29.6)% for FY2026Q3 and (1.1)% year-to-date, driven by discrete stock-based-compensation tax benefits of $772M (Q3) and $918M (YTD) that cannot be forecast. FY2025Q3 GAAP was 11.5%, close to 13%. Because I apply the normalized rate to GAAP-basis operating income and assume no such discrete benefits, forecast tax is probably higher than recent GAAP prints, i.e. conservative.
rationales.share_change_qoq: +0.4% per quarter. Q-5 / the release share-count overview guide FY2026Q4 diluted shares of about 1,668M vs 1,661M actual (F-15b3d74691), i.e. +0.42%, including shares for the pending Taalas and World Labs acquisitions. The trailing trend is similar: 1,626M (F-49b014e4f6) to 1,661M over six quarters, about +0.36% per quarter. Not modelled: customer warrants for up to 320M shares (periodic.txt). They are excluded from diluted EPS until vested and exercisable, and are a material dilution risk.
rationales.other_income: Set to zero (model default). Q4 guide for other income net of interest expense is about $4M (release_ex99_2.txt outlook slide), which is immaterial. Warrant-liability remeasurement (a $1,097M charge in FY2026Q3) depends on the stock price and cannot be forecast.
